shortDescription: Manages NetStream template configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: collect_counter
options.description: Configure the number of packets and bytes that are included in the flexible flow statistics sent to NSC.

options.name: collect_interface
options.description: Configure the input or output interface that are included in the flexible flow statistics sent to NSC.

options.name: description
options.description: Configure the description of netstream record. The value is a string of 1 to 80 case-insensitive characters.

options.name: match
options.description: Configure flexible flow statistics template keywords.

options.name: record_name
options.description: Configure the name of netstream record. The value is a string of 1 to 32 case-insensitive characters.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: type
options.description: Configure the type of netstream record.
